title: Discovery of Tutankhamun's Tomb
summary: On 4 November 1922, British archaeologist Howard Carter and his Egyptian excavation team uncovered the entrance steps to the subterranean tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun (KV62) in the Valley of the Kings. Opened on 26 November with financial backer Lord Carnarvon, the virtually undisturbed four-room tomb yielded thousands of intact royal artifacts, including golden shrines and the young pharaoh's sarcophagus, transforming global public interest in ancient Egyptian civilization.

uncertainty.note: First entrance step uncovered 4 November 1922; inner doorway first breached and entered on 26 November 1922.

as_recorded.value: After a day of clearing, on 4 November, one of the workmen discovered a step cut into the valley floor
